BillingMetricsResponse.description:
D28 panel: charged/outstanding by issue date, collected by approval
(registration) date; totals always per currency, never revalued.
BillingMetricsResponse.title: BillingMetricsResponse

BillingPaymentProjection.description:
Financial delta/snapshot projection by reference (§16.1); never bytes,
bank data, internal notes or conversion internals.
BillingPaymentProjection.title: BillingPaymentProjection

BillingPermissions.description: Financial actions of D27; assistants get nothing until granted explicitly.
BillingPermissions.title: BillingPermissions

ChargeResponse.description: Authorized projection of a charge; drafts never reach the patient (§15.4).
ChargeResponse.title: ChargeResponse

DirectPaymentRequest.description:
Cash or other payment received directly by the practice (staff_entry);
never a simulated patient report (D26).
DirectPaymentRequest.title: DirectPaymentRequest

GrantCreateRequest.description:
Staff request for a limited patient link; the client operationId becomes
the grant id, so a retry never creates a second grant.
GrantCreateRequest.title: GrantCreateRequest

PatientChargeView.description:
Minimal patient projection (§9.3): no internal notes, no other charges,
no clinical content.
PatientChargeView.title: PatientChargeView

PatientReportResult.description: Visible outcome only: never the internal note nor the reviewer identity.
PatientReportResult.title: PatientReportResult

src__api__billing__application__review_c.description:
A partial-reference coincidence only warns the reviewer; it never
rejects or deletes anything by itself (§10.5).
src__api__billing__application__review_c.title: ReferenceWarning

src__api__billing__domain__payments__Dec.description: What the patient states; immutable after submission (§10.4, D26).
src__api__billing__domain__payments__Dec.title: DeclaredPayment

src__api__subscriptions__domain__reports.description: What the client states; immutable after submission (§12.5).
src__api__subscriptions__domain__reports.title: DeclaredPayment

src__api__subscriptions__domain__reports.description:
Partial-reference coincidences only warn the operator; they never
reject or delete anything by themselves (§12.6, D24).
src__api__subscriptions__domain__reports.title: ReferenceWarning

get.description: Devuelve el emisor y cliente OIDC públicos, sin secretos.

post.description: Valida el token OIDC y entrega una credencial nueva una sola vez.
Revoca la instalación y sus credenciales globales; conserva sus referencias.
Revoca la credencial actual y crea su reemplazo en una transacción.
